summary: Verified P0 Beat Lab crop fix and full regression across PLAY/LEARN/CREATE sub-menu pages at desktop (1920x1080), iPhone (390x844), iPad portrait (768x1024) and iPad landscape (1024x768). All 14 hero characters render bottom-centered inside their cards with 0px offset from card center — the framer-motion transform-clobber bug is fixed. All titles render single-line top-center via AutoFitTitle (font sizes shrink from 44px down to 27–41px on long titles like DETECTIVE DR. JELLYBONE / WHO'S GOT THE RHYTHM / CHARLIE'S SONG STUDIO to fit one line). song-studio correctly has no character (background + title only). Header Finn+Shield+Charlie hero row visible on all pages. No 'ResizeObserver loop' runtime overlay observed after load or resize.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix in /app/frontend/src/components/SubMenuPage.js (Tile hero wrapper) is correct: non-motion div owns transform: translateX(-50%), motion.img handles y/rotate only. Clean separation prevents future recurrence.
AutoFitTitle uses rAF-scheduled ResizeObserver — good pattern to silence the benign 'ResizeObserver loop' warning in CRA dev overlay.
Minor: HERO_SCALE cap of 78% works well; jelly-rap-trio (52 * 1.45 = 75.4%) fits with ~48px breathing room on mobile — no risk of edge clipping.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SubMenuPage Tile hero wrapper bug is fixed. Bypass onboarding for automation via localStorage.jma_player_name + jma_onboarded, and sessionStorage.jma_audio_unlocked_v1 via add_init_script before goto.
